name: PDX Youth@Work and SummerWorks
org: Worksystems, Inc. (with the City of Portland, City of Gresham and David Douglas School District)
what_you_do: Paid work with local employers, with hands on skill building. Some tracks focus on fields like building, clean energy, health care and making things.
who_can_apply: Young people ages 16 to 24. The page lists no other rules. Use the interest form to confirm you qualify.
pay_detail: Paid. Hourly rate not stated on the page.
duration: Short-term SummerWorks jobs and year-round PDX Youth@Work experiences; length not stated
deadline_text: No application dates posted. The page does not say whether applications are open. The page links to the PDX Youth@Work Interest Form.
how_to_apply: Complete the PDX Youth@Work Interest Form on the Worksystems page.
notes: It starts at age 16, so 14 and 15 year olds can not join. Oregon BOLI does not give work permits to minors ages 14 to 17. Employers need a certificate to hire minors.
